title: picrasma excelsa
intro: Picrasma excelsa, commonly known as the Kattha tree or Scaphium, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic and Unani medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Picrasma excelsa include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in reducing fever, relieving respiratory issues, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of the plant include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, among others.
